_doc: Recordings for the voice-transcription experiment (qualify_api.evals.voice_transcription). `audio` is relative to this directory and points into audio/, which is git-ignored on purpose (a voice is personal data, and these WAVs weigh ~31 MB). `reference` is the HUMAN transcript, word for word. The six colombia-* cases come from Google's crowdsourced Colombian Spanish corpus (OpenSLR 72, CC BY-SA 4.0, Guevara-Rukoz et al., LREC 2020): ten read sentences of one speaker joined with 0.5 s of silence, the transcripts joined in the same order. Rebuild the WAVs with `just eval-voz-audio`. Add your own recordings to audio/ with a case each. A case whose file is missing is skipped.

cases.reference: Quiero saber qué está pasando en Veracruz.
